1. मू (cf. √ मव् and 1. मीव्) cl. 1. Ā. मवते, to bind, tie, fix, Dhātup. xxii, 71 :
Caus. aor. अमीमवत्, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 80, Sch.:
Desid. of Caus. मिमावयिषति, ib. :
Intens. मामोति, मामवीति, Siddh. on Pāṇ. vi, 4, 20.
2. मू mfn. binding, tying, fixing, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 20, Sch.
the act of binding or tying, L.
3. मू weak form of √ मीव्, q.v.
